summary: Iteration 18 — focused regression on Recipes (NEW), Notice Board 'Add Post' rename, Events month-pills + bold date/time chips + 15-min picker, Spot the Difference bigger pictures + drag panning, Notifications DM Chat/Dismiss buttons, /user/[id] Add Friend 'Already friends' crash fix, and Admin promote/demote. Backend pytest (19 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter18_recipes_admin_spot.py) — 100% pass. Mobile-viewport (390x844) Playwright sweep — every feature in scope works end-to-end. Recipes: full CRUD (list, filter q=ANZAC, GET, PATCH author-only, DELETE author-only, POST comment + recipe_comment notification fires for author, like toggle on/off with count, comment delete) verified server-side; UI verified — 'Post Your Recipe' tile renders on /home, navigates to /recipes, recipe card opens to /recipes/{id} with testIDs recipe-like, recipe-comment-input, recipe-comment-send all functional, comment appears in feed immediately. Notice Board: header pill `new-notice` renders blue background with literal text 'Add Post' (was '+'). Events: `event-month-pills` ScrollView renders; pill testIDs are `month-pill-all`, `month-pill-<YYYY-MM>` (NOT `month-pill-this`/`month-pill-next` as test brief suggested) — labels say 'All upcoming' / 'This month' / 'Next month' as intended; first pill `month-pill-all` is shown. /events/new shows `event-date` and `event-time` chips. /user/{frank_id}: Add Friend tapped while already friends — backend returns 400 'Already friends', UI shows toast and stays on /user/{frank_id} (no red-screen / no nav to /home). Spot the Difference (?theme=garden&difficulty=easy): both scenes render with `std-a-scroll-h` + `std-b-scroll-h`; Magnify ON shows 'Drag to look around' badge and ScrollView scrollWidth (652) > offsetWidth (362) confirming horizontal pan enabled. Notifications screen: with a seeded `type:'dm'` notification, `dm-chat-<id>` and `dm-dismiss-<id>` buttons render under the row, and body shows curly-quoted preview `“Hello from Frank — TEST DM preview”`. Admin Moderators (/admin/promote): `promote-search` field works, searching 'frankie' shows Frank row + `promote-toggle-frankie` Promote button; existing 'Garry' moderator is shown with ADMIN badge + Remove. Two minor specs vs implementation deltas (test brief vs code): (a) Events month-pill testIDs use month-key values, not 'this'/'next' aliases; (b) /admin/promote search testID is `promote-search`, not `admin-search-input`. Neither is a bug — just spec/test naming.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.', 'textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use textShadow.', and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' on virtually every screen render. Non-blocking, carried over from previous iterations.
On /user/[id] taps, console warns 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing'. Web-only fallback to JS animation. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: align test brief's expected testIDs with code — Events uses `month-pill-all` + `month-pill-<YYYY-MM>` (not month-pill-this/next); /admin/promote uses `promote-search` (not admin-search-input). Either update the test plan doc OR add alias testIDs (e.g. month-pill-this/next mirroring current month).
OPTIONAL polish: continue cleaning RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents) when there's a quiet pass available.

OPTIONAL: /games/spot/play crashes with 400 when `difficulty` query param is missing (URL like ?theme=garden returns 'difficulty=undefined' to /api/games/spot/puzzle). Real navigation always sets difficulty, but consider defaulting to 'easy' when missing to be defensive.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4115-4307 (Recipes module) — clean. Author-only / admin-only enforcement consistent across PATCH, DELETE, DELETE-comment. Notifications for recipe_comment fire only when commenter != author (good). Like toggle uses $addToSet/$pull. Title length validated 1..120.

server.py:4068-4111 (admin/users/admin-flag) — safety rails correctly refuse self-demote (400 'You cannot remove your own admin access.') and last-admin demote (400 'At least one admin must remain.'). is_admin unchanged short-circuit returns {ok:true, unchanged:true}.

spot/play.tsx — no `difficulty` default → URL without that param results in /api/games/spot/puzzle?difficulty=undefined → 400. Real entry points always pass a difficulty, but a defensive fallback would be cheap.
notifications.tsx:106 — DM body wrapping `“{body}”` is hard-coded curly quotes; if a translation layer ever lands, those should be locale-aware quotes.
seed_data_creation: One dm notification doc inserted directly into MongoDB (db.notifications) for user_id=friendplace-v1 (Margaret) with id=friendplace-v1 so the dm-chat/dm-dismiss buttons could be UI-verified. Also one TEST_ANZAC recipe + its comments + likes were created and then DELETEd within the pytest run, leaving no residue. Frank's admin flag was toggled True→False during the safety-rails test and ended back as False (Frank is not an admin).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_18 features pass on mobile viewport 390x844. The DM notification UI is fully gated on `item.type === 'dm'`; if you need to test, seed via direct Mongo insert OR send a real WS message (backend POST /dm/start; the WS at /api/ws/dm/{conv_id} actually creates the 'dm' notification — there is no REST POST for DM messages). Spot/play requires both theme AND difficulty query params or you'll see a 400. Events month-pill testIDs are `month-pill-all` and `month-pill-<YYYY-MM>` (not aliased). /admin/promote search testID is `promote-search`. Recipes endpoints under /api/recipes are all working.
rca_of_issue: No new bugs. The two test-brief-vs-code mismatches (month-pill testID naming + admin-promote search testID) are cosmetic spec-vs-implementation drift — the UI functions correctly, just under different testID names than the request claimed.
